candidates.tagline: Ferrari's first EV: looks like a Nissan Leaf, costs $640,000
candidates.story: Ferrari unveiled the Luce, its first all-electric car, and fans immediately called it a sci-fi bubble sedan with no Ferrari DNA — comparisons included Nissan Leaf and AI-generated concepts — causing Ferrari's stock to drop 8% the next day.
candidates.why_funny: The world's most emotionally charged sports car brand built decades of mystique around roaring engines, then debuted a near-silent bubble sedan at the price of a Manhattan studio apartment.
candidates.alt: The Ferrari Luce electric car, a sleek minimalist four-door liftback sedan, shown from a front three-quarter angle against a dramatic backdrop

candidates.tagline: DreamWorks redesigned Shrek so badly they turned off the comments
candidates.story: The Shrek 5 trailer dropped June 16, 2026, revealing redesigned characters with softer contours and Disney-large eyes — sparking such fierce backlash (#NotMyShrek, comparisons to 'AI slop') that Universal disabled YouTube comments entirely.
candidates.why_funny: A studio spent years redesigning an ogre who was already perfectly ugly, made him look like a knockoff Disney sidekick, then silenced everyone who noticed.
candidates.alt: New Shrek 5 animation still showing Shrek with a stunned expression, featuring the controversial redesigned softer, rounder character style with larger eyes
